introduction.message:
1.5.0-beta.1 (#2066)

* 🚩 Updated languages

* Update makesnap (#2019)

* Don't fail on directory creation if exists

* Update snapcraft syntax

Per warning: "Running snapcraft without a command will not be possible in future releases. Use 'snapcraft pack' instead."

* Update command.sh for new executable name (#2023)

Fixes #2021

* ✨ Updated output toggle logic as that did not work always
- Song number sort drawer tab
- Updated Korean language
- Profiles & styles can now sync
- Small fixes

* Switched NDI from polling to event-driven setup

* 🎨 Updated popup UIs
- Tweaks

* Added adaptive throttling

* Added preview loop for thumbnails

* Add arm64 snap builds (#2040)

* Add contingency for arm64 build

* Enable arm64 builds

Was successfully able to build an arm64 snap locally. This enables that.

* snapcraft lint cleanup

Adds a missing dependency

* Fix typo

* 🎨 Updated popup UIs
- Fixed unable to rename project template
- Fixed active style scripture template not highlighted
- Updated language

* ✔️ Stream ratio fix

* Add optional sequencing for Planning Center sections and normalize line endings (#2046)

* ensure consistent line endings and use Planning Center sequence when available to create section slides in the order of the song

* remove temporary debug message

* 🖼️ Media thumbnail will be deleted when original file no longer exists
- UI popup updates

* 🎨 Updated popup UIs

* 🎨 Updated actions popup UI
- Updated event popup

* UI updates

* UI updates

* Export PDF UI updates

* Smarter conditions
- Updated UI

* feat: allow multiple actions of the same type per function (#2060)

- Modified dropActions.ts to respect canAddMultiple setting and only replace actions with identical values
- Updated Action.svelte findExisting() to not auto-replace actions that support multiple instances
- Enhanced addSlideAction() in actions.ts to use canAddMultiple from actionData
- Improved createSlideAction() consistency for canAddMultiple handling

Now users can add multiple 'change_stage_output_layout' actions (and other canAddMultiple actions) to a single function/slide, enabling complex workflows like switching between multiple stage layouts sequentially.

* Enhancements
- Auto scroll to active show in drawer
- Upcomming/next slide group
- Shortcuts
- UI updates
- Fixes

* Updates

* Added pingbackUrl to media

* Pingback only after actually playing the same video for 30 seconds

* Updates
- Fixed Bible list in opposite order

* Widevine (#2065)

* Testing the widevine electron build

* Updated the electron builder with castlabs

* Electron/widevine v37
- getBitmap -> toBitmap

---------
